_readme: Reversible policy overlay for material that remains in registry/manifest provenance but must not be fetched or placed in the training-ready corpus. A restriction stays in force until a reviewed rights decision changes this file.

google_patents_cn_translations.reason: Google identifies non-English Google Patents /en content as translated, and its terms effective 2026-07-30 prohibit using AI-generated service content to develop machine-learning models. Preserve provenance, but use neither the translated payload nor future fetches for training.

jstage_aij_reuse_rights.reason: J-STAGE free access is not a blanket reuse license. Its terms require copyright-holder approval for duplication or derivative databases and prohibit mechanical large-volume download. Exclude existing rows pending verified per-article reuse rights.
